name: item_totals
description: Total quantity of each item type in the world, split into on_ground, carried, stored and machine_stock (material held as reagents inside machines, e.g. electrum ingots loaded into a Pipe Bender, counted as the ingots the machine ejects; a furnace's or centrifuge's working load gets a row of its own with prefab_name null and reagent set), with the holders that hold the most in top_holders (holders_limit of them, default 1 since 1.14.0, 5 before; 0 leaves top_holders out, 1.7.0+), each with kind (player, stored or machine_stock) and position. quantity includes machine_stock; item_count counts items only and machine_stock_entries the machine and reagent pairs. Takes the same filters as find_items, so it answers 'how much iron ingot do I have and where'. Read only; no gateway is needed.

prefab_contains.description: Case-insensitive substring of the prefab name, e.g. 'IngotIron', 'Ore', 'Battery'.

name_contains.description: Case-insensitive substring of the display name, e.g. 'Iron Ingot'.

location.description: ground = loose in the world, player = carried by a player at any depth, stored = in any other holder, machine_stock = held as reagents inside a machine (fabricator stock, a furnace's load). Default any, which includes machine_stock.

within_id.description: Only items inside this thing at any depth (a locker, crate, suit, backpack or player reference ID), and a machine's own stock. An id that names nothing is refused with thing_not_found, never read as an empty holder.

near_player_m.description: Only items whose outermost holder is within this many metres of the player.

holders_limit.description: Holders listed per item type in top_holders, most first; default 1 (5 before 1.14.0). 0 leaves top_holders out.
